summary: Centering the 'Sign Up' button (box 3) matches the design intent, but the 'Username' and 'Password' form labels (boxes 1 and 2) were also unintentionally centered.

regressions.explanation: The 'Username' label text-align changed from start to center, which is an unintended side effect as only the 'Sign Up' button was meant to be centered.
regressions.violated_rule: Design intent: only the 'Sign Up' button in the free trial form was intended to be centered.
